purpose: Bind the facts, expected comparisons, and independent decision fields required when Arm B terminalizes without allowing one successful dimension to imply another.

claim_boundary.terminal_a_b_identity_can_prove: Two independent executions under the bound source package, build provenance, command, host, and runtime environment produced byte-identical retained artifacts.
terminal_a_b_identity_cannot_prove: Universal determinism across arbitrary CPUs, compilers, kernels, filesystems, or floating-point environments.
A Gamma-authored score at or below 105,000,000 bytes.

canonical_input.name: enwik9
canonical_input.sandbox_rule: The canonical corpus is a comparison target outside dependency-sealed decode roots; it must not be mounted as a treatment dependency.

arm_a_comparison.comparison_rule: Arm B archive size and SHA-256 must both equal these retained Arm A values; size equality alone is not identity.

reported_external_score.rule: The reported score is not promoted to an official or Gamma-authored score by Arm B archive identity. Generalized package accounting and official boundary classification remain separate.

resource_lock.rule: Later sampled RSS reduction, successful encode, successful decode, cleanup, or A/B identity cannot change gamma_memory_pass for Arm B.

classification_rules: No aggregate pass field may replace or conceal an independent terminal field.
A null field is unproven, not passed.
A missing receipt is missing evidence, not a failure unless the governing gate requires it for promotion.
Infrastructure or receipt failure is not a compression rejection unless a valid finite archive comparison was reached.
A bare-decode failure does not identify archive corruption unless invocation, dependency, asset, path, and runtime hypotheses are independently excluded.
The Gamma memory failure is terminal for this execution and must remain visible beside every successful result.
The external track always receives zero Gamma authorship and score credit.
terminal_order: Allow the existing wrapper and codec process tree to reach terminal without signaling, reparenting, mutation, or concurrent substantial work.
Preserve the complete terminal result directory before cleanup or lease release changes any runtime metadata.
Finalize the resource observation and terminal VmHWM fields.
Confirm that no encode or decode process remains in the bound process tree.
Invoke cmix_obias_full1g_ab_audit_v2.py read-only against retained Arm A and Arm B receipts; the Arm B runner is not assumed to invoke this auditor.
Release or terminalize the exclusive lease only through receipt-bound terminal processing.
Authorize no correction or scientific successor from partial evidence.
If archive and inverse pass, freeze the bounded external baseline while retaining memory failure and all null official fields.

If archive or inverse fails, preserve terminal evidence and authorize at most one correction-only successor with unchanged corpus, source revision, compression parameters, archive contract, and accounting boundary.
